lines.zh: 我慢慢地从展示位上挪下来。
lines.en: I ease off my display spot.

lines.zh: 我的关节一格一格地转。
lines.en: My joints turn one notch at a time.

lines.zh: 我走得不太稳，像被线牵着。
lines.en: I walk unsteadily, as if on strings.
Light on me, dust drifting.
I round the tables, my steps heavy.
Today I'm allowed to move a little.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子跟着灯的方向转。
lines.en: My snout turns toward the light.
I step down from the stage edge.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛在灯下有点假。
lines.en: My fur looks false under the lamps.
I hitch along as if jammed.
Something rattles inside as I walk.
I walk slowly back to my spot.

lines.zh: 我把地上的彩纸踩过去。
lines.en: I tread over the confetti.
The hall lamps light up one by one.
I count the tiles on the floor.

lines.zh: 我的影子拖在墙上，很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches along the wall.

lines.zh: 我站着，摆出迎客的姿势。
lines.en: I hold a welcoming pose.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直亮着，微弱的。
lines.en: My eyes stay lit, faintly.
By day I'm only decoration.
Light slides over my head.

lines.zh: 我保持着招手的样子，一动不动。
lines.en: I hold a waving pose without moving at all.
Few guests in the afternoon.

lines.zh: 我的头微微歪着，不动了。
lines.en: My head tilts and holds.
I straighten what's in my hands.

lines.zh: 缝线在灯下看得很清楚。
lines.en: The stitching shows plainly in the light.
A car passes outside.
I wait for the closing lamp to die.
This lamp flickers a little.
Dust has settled in my joints.

lines.zh: 一动不动是我最擅长的。
lines.en: Holding still is what I do best.
I hear a music box playing.
A thread of sun through the curtain.
Welcome. By day I only watch.
Too close; I might topple.
My face is sewn together.
Touch me and I'll keep smiling.
How long will you stay? Leave before dark.
I don't move by day. Really.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的眼睛做什么。
lines.en: Why are you staring at my eyes?

lines.zh: 这里晚上会比你想象的吵。
lines.en: It gets louder here at night than you'd think.
My antlers are soft. Don't be afraid.
The row of chairs behind you is empty.
I don't talk much; I only smile.

lines.zh: 你看见玻璃后面的东西了吗。
lines.en: Did you see what's behind the glass?
A patch of my fur is torn.

lines.zh: 头皮缝线裂开，露出里面的骨架。
lines.en: The seam on my scalp splits and shows the frame inside.
A stitch has come loose.
What's inside shows through.

lines.zh: 我的一只鹿角歪了，毛还在掉。
lines.en: One antler is bent and fluff keeps falling.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的姿势。
lines.en: That broke my pose.
My eyes flicker.
A part falls to the floor.
I can still stand. No more.
I must get back to my spot.
Could that lamp be turned off?
Do you have a coin?
When the lights go out, I'm free.
The light is good where you stand.
I stretch my neck slowly toward it.

lines.zh: 那件衣服的颜色，我喜欢。
lines.en: I like the color of that coat.
Someone's started the arcade machine.

lines.zh: 我朝着声音的方向转头。
lines.en: I turn toward the sound.
Could you leave that door open?
That bit of light makes me want to move.
When the music starts, I want to stand up.

lines.zh: 我往舞台那边挪了一寸。
lines.en: I shift an inch toward the stage.

lines.zh: 你把彩球放在我手边了。
lines.en: You set the ball by my hand.
I reach out and barely touch it.
A little more and I'll go over.
That window is blindingly bright.
You bump me and the stand rocks.

lines.zh: 我的头歪向一边，卡住了。
lines.en: My head lolls to one side and sticks.
I lean back into the wall.
Don't push; I'm not well balanced.
My arm clangs against the frame.
You step on the cable at my feet.

lines.zh: 我们撞到一起，灰尘飞起来。
lines.en: We collide and dust rises.
I wobble twice before settling.
My snout brushes your shoulder.
As you step away, I'm still swaying.
Another animatronic stands across from me.
We hold the same pose.
Its fur is older than mine.
Together we watch the door.
The lamps light us; neither moves.
Its eyes are as bright as mine.

lines.zh: 我们中间隔着一张桌子。
lines.en: A table stands between us.

lines.zh: 白天我们只能这样相对。
lines.en: By day this is all we can do.
Come night, it will stand up.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在墙上并排。
lines.en: Our shadows line up on the wall.
I bend slowly and pick up the ball.
A coin on the floor; I'll keep it.
I gather the confetti into a pile.
Whose ticket is this?
I pick up a tuft of fallen fur.
I push it up into my arm.
This hat fits me nicely.

lines.zh: 展示台上的彩球，我摆正。
lines.en: I set the coloured balls straight on the display.
I hold it slowly in both hands.

lines.zh: 有东西滚进展示位底下。
lines.en: Something rolled under the display.
By day I can only watch.
The lights are on. I don't move.
You've spoiled my pose.
Where you are is written down.
When the lights die, it's my turn.

lines.zh: 你听见里面的响声了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear something inside me?

lines.zh: 你退后吧，我快撑不住了。
lines.en: Step back; I'm barely holding this.
What's inside me is moving.
A few hours until dark.
The show hasn't started yet.
I watch you, always smiling.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的头跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my head follows.

lines.zh: 你从舞台前走过两次了。
lines.en: You've passed the stage twice.
The tubes are beginning to buzz.

lines.zh: 我笑着，视线始终落在你肩上。
lines.en: I keep smiling, my gaze fixed on your shoulder.
Just a little longer is all I need.

lines.zh: 你往后退一步，我就往前倾。
lines.en: You step back; I lean forward.

lines.zh: 你走远了，我的头还在慢慢跟。
lines.en: You walk away and my head keeps turning after you.
Look back; I'm still smiling.
When the lights go out, I'm here.

lines.zh: 鹿蹄似的手砸下，桌子裂了缝。
lines.en: My hoof-like hand slams down and the table splits.
This blow lands on the table.
My paw is harder than it looks.
You back off; I keep coming.
My body presses forward, heavy.
This one catches your shoulder.
I knock a chair over.
You dodge, but I'm still moving.

lines.zh: 我的关节发出嘎的一声。
lines.en: One of my joints gives a crack.
I crowd you against the wall.

lines.zh: 舞台的灯亮了，我站好了。
lines.en: The stage lights come on; I'm in place.
A day of display begins.

lines.zh: 我从帘子后面被推出来。
lines.en: I'm wheeled out from behind the curtain.
Someone sets us back in our spots.

lines.zh: 天花板的灯一排排亮起。
lines.en: The ceiling lamps light row by row.
This place needs some decoration by day.

lines.zh: 门上的牌子翻到了营业。
lines.en: The sign on the door turns to open.

lines.zh: 我身上的灰尘被拍掉了。
lines.en: The dust is brushed off me.

lines.zh: 音乐开始了，我抬起了头。
lines.en: The music starts and I lift my head.
I stand in the middle of the floor and wait.
Fire touches me and my fur singes.
I topple and sprawl on the stage.

lines.zh: 水渗进去，我里面短路了。
lines.en: Water seeps in and my insides short.

lines.zh: 白天的我，连站姿都不变。
lines.en: By day, even my pose never changes.

lines.zh: 一枚东西嵌进我的胸口。
lines.en: Something lodges in my chest.
That spell locks my whole body.
I haven't been charged all day.
Lightning makes all my lights flare.

lines.zh: 虚空在拉我，我脚下空了。
lines.en: The void pulls; there's no floor left.
